general.description: Nuwa is an agricultural world, exploited since its discovery the policorporations. too larger, its gravity didn't fit with a confortable life for Humans, so the works is mailny done with drones and robots, shouldered by small teams of engineers. But this arid planet, very fertile with a frail ecosystem, is severly harmed by this over-exploitation of its soils.
general.bar: Agricultural engineers taking a break in a pool-restroom to support the heavy gravity, chatting and waiting for the next shift.
